abstract: The role of extracellular matrix (ECM) in directing cell differentiation has been interpreted so far predominantly in terms of chemical signaling from individual matrix molecules. Recent data, however, suggest that the physical properties of ECM contribute signals for differentiation, which can be decisive and possibly even more important than chemical composition. In the present investigation, effects of different artificial matrices on the differentiation of BeWo choriocarcinoma cells were studied systematically. In Series (a) cells were grown on nonspecifically adhesive substrate gels (gels of glyoxyl agarose with or without poly-L-lysine crosslinked to) and on artificial matrix gels (matrix molecules covalently bound to agarose gels). Differentiation in terms of chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) secretion was stimulated on all artificial gel substrates much more than on rigid substrates of the same chemical composition. Concomitantly a change in morphology was observed to a rounded shape of cells in aggregates attached to the substrate. A series (b) of substrates with gradually reduced adhesiveness was created by coating plastic with different concentrations of poly-HEMA. In this sequence, gradual changes in cell morphology (stepwise approximation to a spherical shape) correlated with increased hCG secretion comparable to that on matrix gels. In contrast, in aggregates kept in suspension the increase in secretion of hCG was only marginal. These results clearly support that in addition to chemical recognition of individual matrix molecules, cells respond strongly to physical properties of extracellular matrix and that the physics of interaction of cytoskeleton, cell surface, and ECM can become decisive for cell differentiation.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoを用いて、各種人工マトリックスが分化に及ぼす影響を系統的に検討した。系列(a)では、非特異的接着性の基質ゲルおよび共有結合でマトリックス分子を固定したアガロースゲル上で細胞を培養した。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌による分化は、同じ化学組成の剛性基質よりも人工ゲル基質上で著明に促進された。同時に、基質に付着した凝集塊の細胞は丸い形態へ変化した。系列(b)では、ポリHEMAでプラスチックをコートし、接着性を段階的に低下させた基質を作製した。この系列では、細胞形態の段階的変化（球状形態への段階的近似）がマトリックスゲル上と同程度のhCG分泌増加と相関した。一方、浮遊培養の凝集塊ではhCG分泌の増加はわずかであった。これらの結果は、個々のマトリックス分子の化学的認識に加え、細胞が細胞外マトリックスの物理的性質に強く応答することを明確に支持する。また、細胞骨格、細胞表面、ECMの相互作用の物理学が細胞分化を規定しうることを示している。
